name: Default
shortDescription: WebCord privacy-hardened Discord and Spacebar desktop client streamed to the browser behind a password, with settings and sessions kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: The app is protected by HTTP basic auth: sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment, then log in to Discord inside WebCord. Anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container, so keep the password private.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
